outcome: Emergent cesarean delivery due to obstructed labor
cohort: 78 pregnant women who underwent MRI pelvimetry due to various risk factors
finding: MRI pelvimetry, particularly SOD measurement, was a reliable tool for predicting obstructed labor in women with a low BMI.
mod_finding: The study found that a sacral outlet diameter (SOD) of less than 10.7 cm was associated with a 5.42 times increased odds of emergent cesarean delivery due to obstructed labor in women with a low BMI.
